newsitem.title: FRANCE: Templeton has 10 pct in Pechiney.
newsitem.headline: Templeton has 10 pct in Pechiney.

text.p: Templeton Global Investors Inc said in a statement on Wednesday that it held more than 10 percent pf the share capital of French aluminium group Pechiney SA and would not sell the stake for the next 12 months.

Templeton said it did not rule out buying more shares in the coming year but was not seeking control of the company and would not demand the nomination of a Templeton member on the Pechiney board of directors.
Templeton held 9.137 percent of Pechiney on December 31, 1996. It now holds 10.07 percent, the statement said.

Templeton said it now held, in various investment funds and client accounts, a total of 7,895,179 ordinary "A" shares and 2,000 preferential investment certificates. There was no immediate comment at Templeton's external public relations company in France about when the 10 percent barrier had been breached. Declarations of intention are compulsory under French bylaws since March 27, 1997.
